title: 「have ／ has yet to + 動詞」表示「至今仍未……」
titleZh: 「have ／ has yet to + 動詞」表示「至今仍未……」

source.file: Sentence Structure 217 -「have _ has yet to + 動詞」表示「至今仍未……」.pdf
omissions: Every numbered Important Rule and Benefit is retained as a separate Chinese-primary card. Where the PDF has no English counterpart, the English explanation is a faithful editorial translation.
The source filename is numbered 217; it is assigned system ID ss218 because the source set contains two distinct PDFs labelled 201.

formula: Subject + have / has + yet + to + base verb + other information

formulas.formula: Subject + have / has + yet + to + base verb + other information
Subject + have / has + yet + to be + past participle + other information

example: The team has yet to respond.

examples.en: The team has yet to respond.
examples.highlight: The team has yet to respond.

meaning.zh: 本課練習目標句型：Subject + have / has + yet + to + base verb + other information。

rules.zh: 按照主語選擇 have 或 has 使用 have： 使用 has：
rules.en: Choose have or has according to the subject. Use have with I, you, we, they and plural subjects: I have yet to ...; You have yet to ...; We have yet to ...; They have yet to ...; The students have yet to .... Use has with he, she, it and singular subjects: He has yet to ...; She has yet to ...; It has yet to ...; The company has yet to ....

rules.zh: yet 放在 have / has 後面 正確： 錯誤：
rules.en: Place yet after have or has. Correct: The manager has yet to reply. Incorrect: The manager yet has to reply.
examples: The manager has yet to reply.
The manager yet has to reply.

rules.zh: to 後面使用動詞原形 正確： 錯誤：
rules.en: Use the base form after to. Correct: She has yet to decide. Incorrect: She has yet to decided. She has yet to deciding.

rules.zh: 句型本身已帶有否定意思 has yet to respond 已經表示「尚未回覆」，因此不需要再加入 not。 正確： 錯誤：
rules.en: The structure is already negative: has yet to respond means “has not responded so far”, so do not add not. Correct: He has yet to respond. Incorrect: He has not yet to respond.
examples: He has not yet to respond.

rules.zh: 被動句使用 yet to be + 過去分詞 （日期尚未確認。） （優勝者尚未公布。）
rules.en: Use yet to be + past participle for the passive: The date has yet to be confirmed. The winner has yet to be announced.
examples: The date has yet to be confirmed.
The winner has yet to be announced.

rules.zh: 這個句型通常暗示事情仍有可能發生 這句表示公司目前仍未發表報告，但報告日後仍可能發表。
rules.en: The structure normally implies that the event may still happen. “The company has yet to release the report” says the report is unreleased now while leaving open the possibility that the company will release it later.
examples: The company has yet to release the report.

rules.zh: 與 have not…yet 的分別 較常見於一般日常對話。 較精簡，並較常見於新聞、報告、正式更新和商業寫作。 兩句的基本意思相同。
rules.en: Distinguish it stylistically from have not ... yet. “The committee has not announced its decision yet” is more common in everyday conversation. “The committee has yet to announce its decision” is more concise and more common in news, reports, formal updates and business writing. Their basic meaning is the same.
examples: The committee has not announced its decision yet.
The committee has yet to announce its decision.

rules.zh: 本練習不包括以下相似句型 以上句型雖然正確，但不屬於本課的主要目標。
rules.en: This exercise excludes several similar but valid structures: be yet to + verb, as in “The minister is yet to respond”; had yet to + verb, as in “They had yet to reach an agreement”; and the fixed expression “The best is yet to come.” They are grammatical but are not the main target here.
examples: The minister is yet to respond.
They had yet to reach an agreement.
The best is yet to come.

benefits.zh: 這個句型能立即讓聽者或讀者知道，某件事情仍未完成，現時仍有待處理。
benefits.en: It clearly shows that something remains unfinished This structure immediately tells the listener or reader that an action has not happened and is still outstanding.

benefits.zh: 你不需要使用「直至目前仍未完成」等較長表達，也可以簡潔地說明事情尚未發生。 比較： 第二句更精簡直接。
benefits.en: It expresses the idea in a concise way Instead of using a longer expression such as “has not completed the work up to now”, you can say “has yet to complete the work”. The school has not announced the results up to now. The school has yet to announce the results.

benefits.zh: 這個句型不只是表示事情沒有發生，通常亦暗示事情日後仍有可能完成。
benefits.en: It suggests that the action may still happen later The structure does not simply describe failure. It often leaves open the possibility that the action will happen in the future.

benefits.zh: 你可以用這個句型交代尚未完成的工作、仍未回答的問題、待定的決定和未解決的問題。
benefits.en: It is useful for giving progress updates You can use it to describe unfinished tasks, unanswered questions, pending decisions and unresolved problems.

benefits.zh: 這個句型讓你不必反覆使用 have not…yet，使說話和寫作的句式更有變化。
benefits.en: It gives you an alternative to repeating not…yet Using have / has yet to allows you to vary your sentences instead of repeatedly using have not…yet.

benefits.zh: 這個句型特別適合用於報告、簡報、新聞寫作、會議更新和職場溝通。
benefits.en: It is suitable for reports and formal updates The structure is especially useful in reports, presentations, news writing, meeting updates and workplace communication.
